packageRules.description: Group the golang.org/x/* modules. They are a coupled set — x/text pulls x/net which pulls x/crypto — so bumping one alone produces an unsatisfiable go.mod (live 2026-08-05: three CI round-trips resolving text -> net -> crypto one at a time).
Go toolchain in the Dockerfiles is deliberately MAJOR.MINOR, not a pinned patch, so a Go security patch is picked up on the next build without a PR. Do not let Renovate pin it back to an exact patch.

customManagers.description: zed is built from source in Dockerfile.tools against a SHA-pinned tag. Track the tag so a new zed release surfaces as a PR; the ZED_COMMIT_SHA next to it must be updated in the same change (the build asserts they match and fails closed if not).
